reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: § 12.3 expressly negates any exclusivity, non-compete, MFC, minimum-volume or no-hire commitment by Customer and confirms Customer's freedom to develop, acquire, license, sell or use any product/service in any field or territory.
§ 12.4 is the only competition restraint and binds Vendor, which the rule expressly permits; § 2.1 confirms no minimum purchase commitment, reinforcing absence of de facto exclusivity.
No redline or comment is proposed, which is correct for a compliant finding; the rendered text is unchanged from the originals.
Deterministic check confirms no open-ended compete restriction on Customer remains, consistent with the preferred position (no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on Customer).
